propositions: T13, T14, removal-rationale, and asserted-capability criteria had zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs due to overly broad applicability triggers.

Deterministic pre-filter rules (DetGateRule with text_all conjunction, file_impact_globs patterns, and file_impact_reason_re) skip criteria only when subject vocabulary is entirely absent, preserving LLM router authority.
Gate skips are recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id and rule name, visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.

Overlay criteria (T13, T14, T5a/T5d/T7/T12) extend _DET_OVERLAY_RULES in registry.py; leaf criteria (removal-rationale, asserted-capability) use parallel _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table with gate block in orchestrator.route_criteria.
asserted-capability fires only when both text_all legs (module-ref and capability-verb) match, enforced by conjunction logic.

Audit-validated trigger regexes for each criterion (T13 enforcement vocabulary, T14 workflow/scheduler vocabulary, removal-rationale weakening/removal vocabulary, asserted-capability module and verb patterns) are implemented and tested against evasion sentences.
